name: BTC exposure cut when the futures basis (carry) is extreme, read from BITO vs spot (lab)
summary: ETF proxy for the BIS crypto-carry crash signal: BITO (rolled CME futures) lags spot BTC by the roll cost, so BTC's 63-day return minus BITO's is a basis proxy; hold BTC except when that proxy is in its top quintile
source: lab (ingredients: BIS WP 1087 'Crypto carry' https://www.bis.org/publ/work1087.pdf (high carry predicts crashes); L-2026-11-07-CARRYPROXY (USO vs USL curve proxy, shortlist 4))
notes: varies I-2026-11-07-CRYPTOCARRY (rejected: no clean basis series) — proxy from two Yahoo series instead of BTC=F | 5-script cap, and data too short: BITO starts 2021-10, so the development window (to 2024-10) is ~3 years with one bear (2022); the 4-5 hour close mismatch (BITO 16:00 ET vs BTC 00:00 UTC) adds ~1-2% noise to a 63-day basis of ~2-5%. Unlock: CME BTC futures settlement history (front/second month) for a true basis series | rule: Weekly (Friday US close): proxy = BTC-USD 63-day return (bar dated before today) - BITO 63-day return - 0.95%/yr fee x 63/365; T-bills when the proxy is above the 80th percentile of its own trailing 52 weekly readings, else 100% BTC; 25bp; bench BTC-USD; variants 42/126-day window, 70th/90th percentile

name: Crypto volatility responds to a preceding down-trend within minutes (Bicki-Akdogan, arXiv 2026-11)
summary: Minute-resolution lag study 2020-26: in BTC/ETH the volatility response to a preceding trend has the leverage-effect sign and a one-sided arrow of time (trend leads vol), half-life ~1.5 hours; equities show no such T-odd part at 20 minutes
notes: varies I-2026-11-07-VOLREGIME (vol-regime dependence of BTC trend) | Descriptive, minute-level; decays within ~1.5 hours, invisible at daily frequency | rule: No trading rule. Implied (ours): vol-scaling of BTC exposure reacts to down-trends faster than daily data can — the daily analogue is the vol leg of L-2026-11-07-BTCTRENDVOL

name: Sparse-autoencoder crypto portfolios: lower volatility, no alpha (Han-Qu, arXiv 2026-10)

summary: Mazur-Polyzos: ETF net flows are the dominant predictor of BTC price levels after Jan 2024; DWF Labs (data to Oct 2026): flows follow price — correlation 0.41 same session, 0.09 next day, 0.03 one week ahead

name: Daily RSI-14 mean reversion on Bitcoin with a 20/50 MA comparison (Paramashiva, SSRN 2026-02)
summary: Econometric paper: a 14-period RSI rule returned +1.6% (Sharpe 0.27) in a short out-of-sample window (Jul 2025 - Jan 2026) when BTC fell 17%, while a 20/50 MA crossover lost 3.6%; 0.1% per trade
source: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=6467818 (SSRN abstract HTTP 403 to the scan; rule read from the search-indexed abstract)
notes: varies R-2026-11-08-BTCMAXMIN (MIN leg: oversold reversal) / I-2026-11-07-BTCMARATIO (MA crossover) | Evidence is one ~6-month out-of-sample window; theme 5 (RSI2/IBS short-term reversal died on costs) and BTCMAXMIN's MIN leg (buying 10-day lows) already failed; 5-script cap | rule: Daily: long BTC when RSI(14) < 30, exit to cash when RSI(14) > 70 (standard bands; the paper's exact thresholds not reachable); MA leg = 20/50-day SMA crossover (same family as I-2026-11-07-BTCMARATIO)

name: Bitcoin pre-holiday drift with a 10-day-high filter (Quantpedia 2025, Dujava)
summary: Hold BTC from the close before a US public holiday to the close after it, but only when BTC is at a 10-day high; Sharpe > 0.6 reported 2018-25 (BTC futures/BITO), base version without the filter 'not satisfactory'
notes: varies R-2026-11-08-BTCMAXMIN (same MAX10 filter) / I-2026-11-07-BTCCAL (calendar family) | 5-script cap; ~10 holidays/yr x 2 days = ~5% time in market, so t >= 3 and the DSR gate are out of reach; the filter is BTCMAXMIN's MAX10 (btc-maxmin family, 20 honest trials) restricted to holidays | rule: For each US public holiday D: at the close of D-1, if BTC's close >= max of its previous 10 closes, hold 100% BTC to the close of D+1, else T-bills; T-bills all other days; 25bp; variants 5/20-day high

name: Negative weekend crypto returns predict Monday equity declines (Mourey-Shahrour-Soiman, FRL 2025)
summary: 20 largest coins (~85% of market cap): negative weekend returns significantly predict Monday declines in the Nasdaq, Russell 2000 and S&P sectors; positive weekends have no effect; stronger after the May-2022 LUNA collapse
notes: varies I-2026-11-09-WKNDVOL (same weekend channel, returns instead of variance) | The signal is known only before Monday's open, so the trade is Monday open -> close: research_bt passes closes only (needs opens); weekend-return definition and effect sizes not in the abstract | rule: Implied (ours): on Monday, hold QQQ open-to-close only if BTC's Friday-close -> Sunday-close (UTC bars) return >= 0, else T-bills for Monday; QQQ otherwise held as normal

name: Mean-reverting spread: Bitcoin futures ETF vs blockchain-equity ETF (Quantpedia 2025)
summary: Dollar-neutral long BITO / short BLOK (beta 0.93); position sized by how far the spread's equity curve sits from 0% (linear or exponential), daily or monthly; 2021-10 to 2025-01: ~5-8%/yr, short legs lost money monthly
notes: varies none (first crypto-ETF pairs idea; cousin of L-2026-11-07-ETHBTCROT relative trend) | BITO starts 2021-10: ~3 development years; the rule anchors on the spread's level since inception (path-dependent, one regime); research_bt has no short-funding model (theme 12 'FX interest' gap) | rule: Daily: spread = cumulative return of (BITO - BLOK) since inception; position in the spread = -1 x its deviation from 0% (20% below -> 20% long), linear; borrow at AMERIBOR

summary: BTC, ETH, LTC 2015-21: returns on turn-of-the-month days are positive and significantly higher than other days, not explained by day-of-week or January effects; a TOM strategy beat buy-and-hold BTC by 21.8%/yr (paper's claim; costs not confirmed). name: Pi Cycle Top: exit Bitcoin when the 111-day SMA crosses above 2x the 350-day SMA (Swift 2019)

name: Volatility-managed Bitcoin (Moreira-Muir 2017 applied to BTC, canon)
summary: Scale BTC exposure by the inverse of last month's realised variance (no trend signal), capped at 100%: Moreira-Muir show variance timing raises Sharpe for equity factors; untested on BTC alone in the ledger
source: https://doi.org/10.1111/jofi.12513 (Moreira & Muir, JF 2017; out-of-sample critique Cederburg-O'Doherty-Wang-Yan, JFE 2020 https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfineco.2020.04.015)
